gates.citation: Kendall MG (1938) tau. Reference impls: scipy.stats.kendalltau and base R stats::cor.test(method='kendall'). Data: eyes-closed-foam COP path length (PhysioMoCap::swayMetrics) vs Trail Making Test A time, Santos & Duarte (2016) BDS balance dataset.

reference.citation: Kendall MG (1938) tau. Reference impls: scipy.stats.kendalltau and base R stats::cor.test(method='kendall'). Data: eyes-closed-foam COP path length (PhysioMoCap::swayMetrics) vs Trail Making Test A time, Santos & Duarte (2016) BDS balance dataset.
reference.description: re-computes Kendall's tau-b of eyes-closed-foam sway vs TMT-A with scipy.stats.kendalltau and base R cor.test(method='kendall') and confirms kendallTau reproduces both bit-for-bit; also reports the normal-approximation z, Pearson r and Spearman rho on the same data and the sample size
